newsitem.title: ITALY: UPS opens "Express Points" in Milan, Rome.
newsitem.headline: UPS opens "Express Points" in Milan, Rome.

text.p: United Parcel Service Italia is opening two town centre "Express Point" facilties in Rome and Milan, the company said in a statement.
The Milan facility will open today, and will be soon be followed by that in Rome, it added. They will be open from 0830 to 1930 local Monday to Fridays with last shipments accepted at 1900.
UPS Italia workers have recently been on strike and holding protest meetings against the company's plans to cut 150 jobs out of 900 in Italy, industry sources said.

The company said the opening of the two Express Points underlines its willingness to invest and to guarantee a wider and better selection of services to clients,"in an important and strategic market" like Italy.
